create_CameraInstance3DBoxes: create CameraInstance3DBoxes from a tensor with x, y, z, x_size, y_size, z_size, yaw values
get_corners_CameraInstance3DBoxes: get the 8 corner coordinates of all 3D camera boxes in clockwise order
rotate_CameraInstance3DBoxes: rotate camera 3D boxes and optional points by a given angle around the y axis
flip_CameraInstance3DBoxes: flip camera 3D boxes horizontally or vertically in the BEV plane
convert_to_LiDAR_CameraInstance3DBoxes: convert camera 3D boxes to LiDAR coordinates using a rotation and translation matrix
